name: Band Squat
description: A harder leg exercise that also mobilises the hips, knees and ankles: squat down and back up with the band under your feet and the ends at your waist.

source.title: British Heart Foundation: resistance band exercises
source.note: Standing version. The article also shows each exercise seated on a chair.

setup: Stand with your feet hip-width apart on the middle of the band.
Hold the ends at your waist.
cues: Bend your knees only as far as is comfortable.
If standing up is too hard, try the leg press instead.

prescription.note: Aim for 2 to 3 sessions a week with a rest day between. If you have a heart condition or high blood pressure, check with your doctor or cardiac rehab team first.

keyframes.name: Stand
keyframes.cue: Band under both feet, ends at your waist.

keyframes.name: Squat
keyframes.cue: Lower your hips and bend your knees as far as is comfortable.
